positions without touching `|` are checked.
- There is no meaning involved, only shared character patterns.

I made three design choices of my own:
- I removed LayerNorm and the MLPs and use per-layer head sizes.
- The `|` position fetches only itself in layer 1, so its window is all zeros and the sentinel key always scores exactly 15.5.
- Sentence-1 windows that would start before position 0 are blocked from being matched.

Final model: `interpretable_transformers_lib/hash8_window_match_v1.py`.
